data.label: crawler-sync-age
data.sensorReads: how many hours since the sync sensor last wrote its gauge file (node-exporter textfile mtime on Library). chorus_sensor_reading_age_days cannot say this: it counts days behind the sensor's own newest reading, so a sensor that stops reads 0 forever. A sync sensor with no reading at all reads 1000000 hours (absent()), so it is never silence: rules are built with noDataState OK (Kade).
